details: Bitcoin's price is largely consolidating around the $64,000 to $64,500 range, showing a slight positive movement of less than 1% in the last 24 hours. The cryptocurrency's price retreated from a one-month high, influenced by surging crude oil prices and renewed inflation concerns impacting risk assets. Analysts point to the $68,000 level as a critical resistance. The total crypto market cap sits around $2.27-$2.29 trillion, with Bitcoin's dominance at approximately 57-58%.
title: Bitcoin Consolidates Above $64,000 Amid Mixed Signals

details: Shiba Inu (SHIB) has surged notably, with gains reported between 27% and 36% in the past 24 hours, driving a broader rally in the meme coin sector. Other meme coins like MemeCore (M) also saw increases, with MemeCore gaining over 8%.
title: Shiba Inu (SHIB) Leads Meme Coin Rally with Significant Gains

details: Cryptocurrency exchange BitMart has announced a phased shutdown of its trading platform, leading to a significant crash in its native token, BMX, which has fallen over 60% in value.
title: BitMart Exchange Announces Phased Shutdown, BMX Token Crashes
